cand.title: México Hospitality Expo powered by HOSTELCO 2027

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified organizer-side routing contacts, not proven accommodation buyers: Alicia Sandoval, Ejecutiva de organización de eventos, appears on the official form-confirmation page; Sanderson Melo Sacerdys, International Sales Executive, appears under international sales on the official contact page. Alicia is the local organizer route and Sanderson the international/Fira route. Their hotel-contract authority is unverified; confirm Alicia’s current assignment because the main contact page now uses a generic local role.
findings.futureEdition: Official activity dates are 6–8 July 2027, 10:00–18:00, at Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B. The venue calendar and organizer exhibitor page agree. These are event dates, not publication dates, and fall inside the requested horizon. Some organizer pages still contain 2026 headings/programmes; do not transfer their content or hotel validity dates to 2027.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong city/expo-hotel fit for the supplied 216-room full-service Sheraton product, not a resort-led opportunity. The exhibition remains at Expo Guadalajara and the organizer already listed this exact hotel in 2025 and 2026. Prospect segments are nonlocal exhibitors, visitors, organizer/speaker teams and hosted buyers; the hosted-buyer accommodation benefit establishes a real historical housing pathway. Guestroom bookings and ancillary private meetings are sales hypotheses, not confirmed 2027 demand. No room-night conversion or allocation of all 216 rooms is justified.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 exhibition venue is publicly confirmed as Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B, a convention/exhibition venue rather than a competing hotel. This is a published venue commitment, not inspection of a signed contract. No 2027 accommodation commitment was verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented editions: 6–8 May 2025 at Expo Guadalajara; 6–8 October 2026 at Expo Guadalajara; next edition 6–8 July 2027 at the same venue. No destination rotation appears in this documented timeline. Recurrence is evidenced by successive editions, but neither a fixed annual month nor a 2028 date is established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN / UNCONFIRMED for 2027, not open and not proven closed. Two historical pathways are published: direct hotel bookings using event codes/rates in 2025, and a 2026 hosted-buyer programme explicitly including hotel accommodation, flights and ground transfers. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is listed among 2026 hoteles sede and had a 2025 event-rate listing. Neither listing proves a guaranteed block, room allocation, exclusivity, actual pickup or renewal for July 2027. No named housing agency, PCO or hotel-contract signatory was established.
findings.organizationStructure: A jointly organized commercial HORECA trade exhibition: Expo Guadalajara and Fira de Barcelona/Fira Barcelona International through HOSTELCO. Expo Guadalajara is both local co-organizer and exhibition venue; Fira supplies the international organizer/brand relationship. The evidence does not support classification as an education/scientific association-owned congress, despite educational/congress content. No separate contracted PCO/DMC was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2026 hotel list also names Barceló Guadalajara, The Westin Guadalajara, VOCO by IHG and European Life Style Executive Suites. The separate 2025 list additionally includes RIU Guadalajara, Real Inn and Hampton Inn Expo. These are historical published alternatives, not confirmed 2027 incumbents or evidence of equivalent commercial terms. Sheraton itself is already a historical listed partner. No sourced sellout, denied demand, overflow requirement or exclusivity was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First reconcile Sheraton’s internal 2025/2026 event-code agreements, pickup, account ownership and any existing July 2027 commitments. Then approach Alicia Sandoval, copying info@mhe.mx after verifying her assignment, to ask who manages 2027 hoteles sede and hosted-buyer lodging, whether selection is underway or complete, and how Sheraton can renew. Use Sanderson Melo Sacerdys for international exhibitor/hosted-buyer routing, not as a presumed hotel buyer. Request dates of stay, room nights, peak, payer/guarantee, rates, allotment, cutoff and any exclusivity before offering inventory. Position an optional event booking code and small team/hosted-buyer allocations subject to availability; do not fabricate a block or RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026, the October 2026 dates are past and cannot be sold as an upcoming opportunity. The July 2027 edition is confirmed, but hotel procurement accessibility remains unconfirmed. Public organizer commercial contacts permit relationship outreach, not a claim that hotel inventory or a formal RFP is open.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize renewal/reactivation and increased share for July 2027 rather than displacement of an exclusive host hotel. Historical Sheraton listings provide a relationship anchor; the hosted-buyer programme offers a second organizer-mediated accommodation conversation. Beyond 2027, nurture the series without advertising an unannounced 2028 edition or fixed annual cadence.
